theme: Light theme first, warm founder-friendly palette with a dark mode counterpart.
archetype: 1 (Organic & Earthy) crossed with Notion/Attio calm productivity.
vibe: Calm intelligence, warm and inviting. Inspired by Artisan (artisan.co), Notion, and Attio. No purple SaaS cliches. High legibility, generous whitespace.

mono.usage: Data points, integration keys, lead IDs

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-stone-900 dark:text-stone-50
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-stone-900 dark:text-stone-50
scale.tiny: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-stone-400 dark:text-stone-500

buttons.primary: bg-[#0F4C3A] hover:bg-[#0A3B2C] text-white rounded-xl px-4 py-2 transition-transform active:scale-[0.98] dark:bg-[#34D399] dark:hover:bg-[#10B981] dark:text-stone-950
buttons.secondary: bg-stone-100 hover:bg-stone-200 text-stone-900 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 transition-transform active:scale-[0.98] dark:bg-stone-800 dark:hover:bg-stone-700 dark:text-stone-50
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-stone-100 text-stone-600 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 transition-colors dark:hover:bg-stone-800 dark:text-stone-300

cards.dashboard_widget: bg-white dark:bg-stone-900 border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-800 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300
cards.integration_card: bg-white dark:bg-stone-900 border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-800 rounded-2xl p-5 flex flex-col gap-4 group hover:border-[#0F4C3A]/30 dark:hover:border-[#34D399]/30 transition-all
cards.lead_card: bg-white dark:bg-stone-900 border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-800 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between hover:bg-stone-50 dark:hover:bg-stone-800/50 cursor-pointer transition-colors

pills.mode_switcher: bg-stone-100/50 dark:bg-stone-800/50 p-1 rounded-full inline-flex items-center backdrop-blur-sm
pills.mode_tab_active: bg-white dark:bg-stone-700 shadow-sm rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-stone-900 dark:text-stone-50 transition-all
pills.mode_tab_inactive: px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-stone-500 dark:text-stone-400 hover:text-stone-700 dark:hover:text-stone-200 transition-all
pills.status_live: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium
pills.status_coming_soon: bg-stone-100 text-stone-600 dark:bg-stone-800 dark:text-stone-400 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium

components.inputs: bg-stone-50 dark:bg-stone-950 border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0F4C3A]/20 transition-all

app_shell.structure: Flex row. 240px fixed Sidebar on left. Main content area takes remaining width. ARIA drawer (380px) slides in from right.
app_shell.header: Sticky top, h-16, backdrop-blur-md bg-white/70 dark:bg-stone-900/70 border-b border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-800 flex items-center justify-between px-6 z-40

dashboards.b2c_automation: Focus on visual funnels and ROI. Top row: 4 summary metrics. Middle: Channel ROI Recharts bar chart + Ghost-lead recovery feed. Bottom: Winning channel combinations.
dashboards.b2b_founder: Focus on high-level pipeline and actions. Top row: Aria's Daily Top 3 Actions. Middle: Pipeline coverage chart + ICP fit signals grid. Bottom: Deal risk heatmap.
dashboards.b2b_sales: Focus on speed and competition. Top row: Rep leaderboard + Activity metrics. Middle: Coaching nudges list + Forecast confidence timeline.
dashboards.widget_composition: Strict bento-box grid style. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6.

leads_page.style: Attio-style dense spreadsheet. White/Stone-900 background, extremely subtle 1px borders. Sticky headers.
leads_page.kanban_toggle: Top right pill toggle to switch to Kanban view. Columns are tight, rounded-xl.

conversations_inbox.style: Superhuman-inspired. Left sidebar (280px) for list. Right pane for reading/replying. Keyboard-first hints (Cmd+Enter, E to archive) visible in tooltips.
conversations_inbox.aria_drafts: Inline soft-green blocks within the email body showing Aria's suggested reply.

integrations_page.style: Keep structural grid (54 items), but apply the new card aesthetics. White rounded-2xl cards with 1px stone-200 borders, hover state lifts card slightly.

drawer.style: bg-white/80 dark:bg-stone-900/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-l border-white/40 dark:border-white/5 shadow-2xl rounded-l-3xl overflow-hidden
drawer.trigger: Floating button bottom-right OR Cmd+J shortcut
drawer.header: Contains Aria avatar, 'Aria' title, and a 'Minimize' icon button.

cards.style: bg-[#FDFBF7] dark:bg-stone-950 border border-stone-200/50 dark:border-stone-800 rounded-2xl p-4 mb-4
types: Aria Noticed: Soft coral accent. Alerts about ghosting leads.
Aria Drafted: Soft green accent. Pre-written emails ready to send.
Aria Suggests: Primary green accent. Coaching tips or next steps.

motion.hover: Notion-esque calm hovers. Use Framer Motion layoutId for the mode switcher pill background. No bouncy springs.
motion.page_transition: opacity: 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0, duration: 0.3s, ease: easeOut

founder_hooks.greeting: On load, top of dashboard says 'Good morning, Sarah. Pipeline is looking healthy today.'
founder_hooks.proactive_ai: 'Aria noticed 3 hot leads went cold' card appearing smoothly after 2 seconds of inactivity.
founder_hooks.celebration: When moving a deal to 'Closed Won' in Kanban, emit a subtle green glow effect on the card.
founder_hooks.keyboard_shortcuts: Display subtle 'Press Cmd+K' tags on primary buttons to encourage power-user behavior.

aria_avatar.description: Smiling professional woman (Aria's humanized persona) used for the AI companion avatar.

testing_guidelines.rule: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup the global CSS and Tailwind config first. Inject the custom colors, typography (Outfit & Manrope), and border radii.
2. Build the App Shell: Implement the Sidebar navigation and the persistent floating ARIA drawer structure.
3. Build the Dashboard Core: Create the mode switcher (B2C / B2B Founder / B2B Sales / Hybrid) with Framer Motion layoutId.
4. Implement the Demo Dashboards: Use Recharts for data. Apply the 'bento-box' grid strategy. Use the new card aesthetics.
5. Revamp Integrations Page: Apply the new light/dark theme, border colors, and pill styles to the existing 54-item grid. Do not break the layout, just reskin it.
6. Build Leads & Conversations: Implement the dense Attio-style spreadsheet and Superhuman-style inbox.
7. Implement ARIA interactions: Add the ChatGPT-style cards inside the drawer and ensure they pop gracefully.
8. Ensure every button, input, and interactive card has a `data-testid` attribute.
